# Version 4.147.0
> **Skia m147 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.147.0-preview)

> **Superseded by [4.148.0](4.148.0.md)** · Never released as stable — these changes rolled up into 4.148.0.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.147.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1.6/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.147.0 previews Skia m147 with variable fonts, animated WebP encoding, and expanded platform support. It adds color font palettes, controllable surface sampling, zero-copy stream access, and new Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets. This preview also drops older Tizen and WebAssembly targets, so review the migration notes before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **Pre-.NET 8 WebAssembly native assets removed** — The WebAssembly packages no longer include native assets for Emscripten versions used by .NET 6 and .NET 7. Move Blazor WebAssembly and Uno WebAssembly projects to .NET 8 or later before upgrading. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))
- **32-bit Tizen native assets removed** — The Skia m147 update removes the EOL tizen-arm and tizen-x86 native assets. Move Tizen applications to the supported tizen-arm64 or tizen-x64 runtime identifiers. ([#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo renamed to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo** — The Vulkan YCbCr conversion info struct now follows the `GR` casing convention, and `GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo` uses the new type. Update source references to `GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo`; a compatibility shim remains for migration. ([#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))
- **SKStream.Move rejects offsets outside Int32 range** — The legacy `SKStream.Move(long)` overload now uses a checked conversion because the native API accepts a 32-bit offset. Use an Int32-range offset or handle `OverflowException` instead of relying on silent truncation. ([#3714](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3714))
- **Assembly version moved to 4.x** — SkiaSharp.dll now reports assembly version 4.147.0.0 instead of 3.119.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and any hard-coded assembly-version checks. ([#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))

## Engine

- **Skia updated from m119 to m147** — The bundled engine advances through m132 and m133 to m147, bringing newer image-codec orientation handling, HDR and wide-gamut improvements, and accumulated raster and filter fixes. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **Bundled image and font dependencies refreshed** — libexpat moves to 2.7.5, libpng to 1.6.58, zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley, FreeType to 2.14.3, and libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1. ([#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012))

## API Surface

- **Variable fonts and color font palettes** — SKTypeface, SKFontArguments, and HarfBuzzSharp gain APIs for querying variation axes, selecting design coordinates, choosing palettes, and overriding palette colors. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Sampling options for surface draws** — New SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface overloads accept SKSamplingOptions so callers can control filtering and mipmapping. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))
- **Animated WebP encoding** — SKWebpEncoder can encode single images or frame sequences to animated WebP through span-based frame APIs. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771))
- **Zero-copy access to memory-backed streams** — SKStream.GetData() returns the backing SKData when the native stream can expose it without copying. ([#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **Additional document, GPU, mask filter, and color APIs** — Adds SKDocument XPS creation overloads, per-resource GRContext.Flush overloads, shader-backed mask filters, SKColorSpace.CreateCicp, and the HBColor value type. ([#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))

## Bug Fixes

- **Default typeface initialization hardened** — Default typeface resolution moves to the managed font manager, preventing Android startup crashes and using an empty typeface when no system font is available. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730), [#3744](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3744), [#3835](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3835))
- **Variable-font spans and glyph checks corrected** — Undersized variation buffers now report and copy values correctly, and the byte-span ContainsGlyphs overload no longer recurses until a StackOverflowException. ([#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **SKPath finalization crash fixed** — SKPath no longer touches a finalized SKPathBuilder when garbage-collection order disposes the builder first. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **Android SKGLView reattachment fixed** — SKGLView retains its dimensions when reattached, so returning to a MAUI TabBar page no longer produces a blank GL surface. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))
- **Apple library target frameworks corrected** — Apple libraries target the base 26.0 platform versions, avoiding an unnecessary requirement for Xcode 26.2. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))

## Platform

- **Linux Bionic native assets** — New linux-bionic-x64 and linux-bionic-arm64 assets support Linux environments built on Android's Bionic libc. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217))
- **64-bit Tizen support** — Native packages add tizen-x64 and tizen-arm64 assets alongside the platform transition away from 32-bit Tizen targets. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **.NET 8 becomes the WebAssembly floor** — WebAssembly native packages retain Emscripten variants for .NET 8 and later and issue a clear build error for older target frameworks. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.6

Ships HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.6 with variable-font APIs, color font palette access, the HBColor value type, and native assets for Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen.
